differences.staticdata: You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centred power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward.

differences.staticdata: You've proven to be a valuable ally to the Marid, and earned Gabel's trust. As long as you stand with the Marid you are welcome to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob. Though the Djinn War has still not ended, the Marid can't fail with you on their side.

differences.staticdata: Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect. As long as you stand with the Efreet, you are permitted to trade to with the green djinns.
